title: Reply: the unsaid things were Gospel mysteries the disciples could not yet bear
source_text: III. Respondeo per multa illa quae testatur Christus se dicenda discipulis habuisse, & quae tamen discipuli ante Christi mortem portare non poterant, intelligi accuratam & distinctam explicationem mysteriorum Evangelicorum, veluti de efficacia & fructu mortis Christi, de resurrectione illius, de ascensione in caelum, & sessione ad dexteram Patris, de vocatione Gentium, & cultus legalis abrogatione, de statu Ecclesiae sub Novo Testamento, aliisque hujusmodi, de quibus quidem breviter & generatim Christus discipulis locutus est, etiam ante mortem; sed ea tamen tunc illi intelligere non poterant, nec eorum accuratam explicationem ferre, propter varia praejudicia quibus mens eorum erat occupata, & tristitiam summam qua dejectus erat illorum animus, & quia nondum acceperant illum veritatis Spiritum qui mentis ipsorum oculos erat illuminaturus, ut Evangelii lucem ferre & aspicere possent.
pass_a_gloss: I answer that by those many things which Christ testifies he had to say to the disciples, and which yet the disciples before Christ death could not bear, is understood the accurate and distinct explanation of the Evangelical mysteries, such as concerning the efficacy and fruit of Christ death, concerning his resurrection, concerning the ascension into heaven, and the sitting at the right hand of the Father, concerning the calling of the Gentiles, and the abrogation of the legal worship, concerning the state of the Church under the New Testament, and other things of this kind, of which indeed Christ spoke briefly and in general to the disciples even before his death; but those things they then could not understand, nor bear their accurate explanation, because of various prejudices by which their mind was occupied, and the extreme sadness by which their spirit was cast down, and because they had not yet received that Spirit of truth who was to illuminate the eyes of their mind, so that they could bear and look upon the light of the Gospel.
pass_b_english: The many things of John 16 are not a blank check for later Roman traditions.
They mean the clear unpacking of Gospel mysteries the disciples could not yet carry.
Cross, resurrection, ascension, session, Gentile call, end of legal worship, New-Testament church — Christ had sketched these briefly.
Prejudice, grief, and the still-missing Spirit blocked full grasp before the Passion.

lemmas.gloss: accurate and distinct explanation of the Evangelical mysteries

choices.english: is understood the accurate and distinct explanation
choices.why: Defines the content of the unsaid without conceding unwritten equal-authority dogma.
rejected: Christ reserved Mass, saints, images for later tradition
